from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError, model_validator

T = TypeVar("T")

NonEmptyList = Annotated[list[T], MinLen(1)]
NonEmptyStr = Annotated[str, MinLen(1)]


class Author(BaseModel):
    name: NonEmptyStr


class CompleteBookPlus(BaseModel):
    title: NonEmptyStr
    source_records: NonEmptyList[NonEmptyStr]
    authors: NonEmptyList[Author]
    publishers: NonEmptyList[NonEmptyStr]
    publish_date: NonEmptyStr


class StrongIdentifierBookPlus(BaseModel):
    title: NonEmptyStr
    source_records: NonEmptyList[NonEmptyStr]
    isbn_10: NonEmptyList[NonEmptyStr] | None = None

+.. _platform_eric_eccli:
+
+Platform Options: Ericsson ECCLI
+=================================
+
+This page documents the available settings for the Ericsson ECCLI platform.
+
+Connection
+----------
+
+Ericsson ECCLI supports the ``network_cli`` connection type.
+
+.. code-block:: yaml
+
+   hosts:
+     ericsson:
+       hosts:
+         sw1:
+           ansible_host: 192.168.0.1
+       vars:
+         ansible_network_os: eric_eccli
+         ansible_connection: network_cli
+         ansible_user: admin
+         ansible_password: secret
+
+Privilege Escalation
+---------------------
+
+Enable mode can be used to enter privileged configuration mode.
+
+.. code-block:: yaml
+
+   vars:
+     ansible_become: true
+     ansible_become_method: enable
+     ansible_become_user: admin
+     ansible_become_password: secret

.. _platform_eric_eccli:

Platform Options: Ericsson ECCLI
=================================

This page documents the available settings for the Ericsson ECCLI platform.

Connection
----------

Ericsson ECCLI supports the ``network_cli`` connection type.
